title: The Animal That Sees Ultraviolet
short_teaser: Many birds and insects can detect ultraviolet wavelengths invisible to humans.
story: Many birds and insects can detect ultraviolet wavelengths invisible to humans. Flowers, feathers, and signals may look completely different to them. Reality is larger than the portion our senses can receive. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Reality is larger than the portion our senses can receive. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed.
